source_baseline.source: P1 completed BFP8/HiFi2 run, all108 output rows and root forecast-miss accounting

method: Apply explicit multipliers to the complete P1 measured case-generation wall, model load, and outside-load/preparation wall. Frozen manifest checks confirm all108 P1 jobs have branches=[] and one free-running trial; the baseline excludes chosen teacher-forcing branches.
uncertainty: BF16/HiFi4 has not been run; high 3x case-generation and 2x load/preparation are conservative planning stress multipliers, not statistical bounds.
Changing logits can alter sampled trajectories and early-stop lengths, so output work may diverge from P1 despite the same caps; factors approximate that uncertainty, they do not bound it.
No candidate memory-fit/capacity or serving-speed claim follows from this forecast.
P1 completed wall was2018.039s against prior [2515.763,5878.864]s; root accepted the exact low forecast miss and provided component accounting.
The P1 workload has no chosen teacher-forcing branch (0 chosen TF tokens); the candidate panel has the same frozen manifest, so the forecast is a free-run reproduction estimate only.
